sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details unauthorized card-not-present activity involving customer C09988 and credit card C09988-K1. On December 11, 2016, at 22:39:08 UTC, an unauthorized online transaction (ID 3534820) in the amount of $59.67 was conducted on card C09988-K1. Customer C09988 contacted the institution on December 12, 2016, explicitly disavowing the transaction as unauthorized. An examination of the cardholder baseline revealed zero prior transactions and no recurring payment profile to support the charge. The transaction was processed online from an unverified geographic location using device D000431, displaying a browser profile of Windows, unknown vendor, Edge 16.0, unknown hardware. The device was designated as New for the account and generated a mismatch flag M4 indicating M1. Graph analysis established that device D000431 was previously utilized in ten confirmed fraud cases, including CC-5057, CC-3580, CC-2765, CC-2732, CC-2675, and CC-2540. In the seven-day period surrounding the alert, device D000431 displayed an elevated risk lift of 6.46 across four additional cards: C04965-K2, C07196-K2, C08374-K1, and C09616-K1. Total confirmed suspicious exposure on card C09988-K1 is $59.67. The institution has blocked card C09988-K1 and initiated monitoring on all connected card accounts.

stop_reason: Investigation closed under policy section 6 because decisive fraud probability of 0.91 was established with multiple independent lines of evidence, including direct cardholder denial, device novelty, and corroborated graph links to ten confirmed fraud cases and four connected cards.
